Home / About

A field guide, not an official site.

Better Ibaan is an independent civic project. It gathers what the Municipality of Ibaan and other public sources already publish, and puts it in one readable place.

No ads. No tracking. No contact form. No claim to speak for the town.

On this page PurposeSix sectionsHow facts are handledWhat is left out

Why “Iba ang Ibaan”?

The town is named for the Iba tree. In Tagalog, iba also means “different.” The phrase leans on both meanings, but the guide does not need the pun to work. It is simply the shortest way to say: this place is specific, and it deserves a specific guide.

What this is

  • A sourced field guide to Ibaan, Batangas, with the same section structure as a full town reference.
  • A readable index of offices, services, officials, barangays, statistics, procurement, and archives.
  • A static site with no accounts, no comments, and no advertising.
  • An open-data project: the datasets and boundary geometry are downloadable.

What this is not

  • Not an official website of the Municipality of Ibaan.
  • Not a substitute for a municipal office, the Sangguniang Bayan, or a legal record.
  • Not a complete archive. If a page is missing, it may simply not have been added yet.
  • Not a source of legal, property, or boundary advice.

How facts are handled

Municipal facts come from the Municipality of Ibaan's own pages. Population and household figures are the 2020 census values as stated in the municipal profile. The Iba tree feature is a summary of the municipality's Filipino-language heritage entry. The English is ours, not an official translation.

Where official pages disagree, the guide records the disagreement and leaves the figure out. The municipal profile and its geography section currently give different elevations and different distances to Manila. Neither figure is published here.

How the maps are handled

The barangay and provincial maps use the PSA and NAMRIA 2023 administrative boundary file, as published in the MIT-licensed barangay-boundaries-repository. The geometry is simplified at roughly 500 metres. The map is an orientation aid, not a survey.

Technology

Better Ibaan is a static Astro site. Search, the barangay filter, the theme control, and the map readout run in the browser. There is no backend and no analytics script. The site uses self-hosted Source Serif 4 and Public Sans.

Official starting point

If you need an official answer, the municipal profile is the right place to begin. The sources page lists the rest.

What is not filled in

This guide does not borrow a figure from another town to make a page look complete. These are the open fields.

  • PSGC codes for Ibaan and its barangays

    Could not verify

    PSA classification pages were not reachable from this build. No PSGC code appears on the official Ibaan pages.

    Philippine Statistics Authority · PSGC ↗

  • Effective date and issuance for the second-class income classification

    Could not verify

    Both the municipal profile and CMCI state second class, but neither gives an effective date or issuing order.

    Municipality of Ibaan · General Information ↗

  • Barangay-level population and household counts

    Could not verify

    The municipal profile publishes only town-level 2020 census figures. PSA census tables were not reachable from this build.

    Philippine Statistics Authority · Census and Housing ↗

  • Local holiday calendar

    Not published

    No dedicated holiday list was found in the municipal navigation, announcements, or advisories.

    Municipality of Ibaan · Announcements archive ↗

  • Local ordinances, resolutions, and executive orders

    Not published

    No Ibaan-specific local legislation repository was found. The CMCI document library did not show Ibaan entries when checked.

    DTI · Local Ordinances and Resolutions ↗

  • Narrative town history with dates

    Not published

    The municipal site has profile and heritage pages, but no history page. This guide does not import unsourced historical claims.

    Municipality of Ibaan · General Information ↗

  • Annual budgets, financial statements, and audit reports

    Not published

    No public finance documents were found in the municipal navigation or archive pages.

    Municipality of Ibaan · Bid Results ↗

  • DILG Full Disclosure Policy filings

    Could not verify

    The DILG disclosure portal did not resolve from this build, and no local mirror was found on the municipal site.

    DILG · Full Disclosure Policy Portal ↗

  • Emergency hotline numbers

    Could not verify

    The municipality publishes its hotline list as an image. The numbers are not transcribed here because they cannot be checked as text.

    Municipality of Ibaan · Hotlines ↗
